# Docker Mailserver API

> Administrative API for accounts and mail. Email operations require an operator-supplied bearer token.

## Documentation

- [Agent usage guide](/docs)
- [OpenAPI contract](/docs/openapi.json)

GET /v1/messages/latest returns the full latest received message across managed INBOXes, or 204 when all are empty.
GET /v1/accounts/{email}/messages/latest returns the full latest message, or 204 when the folder is empty.
